headline: Individual Passes Following Chemical Plant Fire In Salto, Brazil
seoTitle: Vítima dies after chemical plant fire in Salto
metaDescription: A person injured in the November 13 fire at the Pyrozzar Pirosol chemical plant in Salto, São Paulo, has died from their injuries, officials report.
aiSummaryBullets: One person has died following an industrial fire at the Pyrozzar Pirosol chemical facility.
The incident occurred on November 13 in the municipality of Salto, located in the interior of São Paulo.
The victim passed away on the afternoon of November 18 after being hospitalized for injuries sustained during the fire.
aiContextParagraph: On November 13, 2026, a significant fire broke out at the Pyrozzar Pirosol chemical plant situated in Salto, a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. The facility specializes in chemical manufacturing, and the emergency prompted an immediate response to contain the blaze and attend to those affected. On November 19, local reports confirmed that one individual who had been identified as a victim of the incident succumbed to their injuries the previous afternoon. This event has drawn local attention regarding workplace safety and the specific conditions surrounding the industrial accident. As the investigation into the fire continues, details regarding the casualty have been provided by local news sources monitoring the aftermath in the region. The tragedy highlights the risks associated with operations within the chemical industrial sector in the state of São Paulo.
